items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Well, yeah, years ago I used to play with a band called Original Royal Jazz Band. A fella called Joe Harris, he's a trombone player. He died probably a few years ago. He was the leader of this band.

ctx.x: Was there any other band you played with for a while before you joined Celestan, aside from just jobbing around, you know?

Well, yeah, years ago I used to play with a band called Original Royal Jazz Band. A fella called Joe Harris, he's a trombone player. He died probably a few years ago. He was the leader of this band. And he belonged to the Oddfellas. That's how I happened to play at the fairgrounds so often. And then we used to play parades too. He'd get up a band and we'd play a parade for the Oddfellas. And he was one of the big shots in the Oddfellas. So he would get all these jobs, you see? Yeah. And we'd parade them all over…
Remember any other people in the band, the trumpet player, Cornette, who used to?
